Not sold on commendability

> Mindful of Staidear's tireless efforts to demand better from Declansburg’s elected officials during the fall of 2022, an advocacy effort that culminated in Staidear’s run for Prime Minister against the region’s undefeated incumbent in November of that year,
> 
> Respecting that Declansburg’s November 2022 elections saw Staidear declare candidacy for a multitude of elected government offices, as a protest of dissent against the region’s doomed state of affairs,
> 
> Aware of Staidear's one-vote victory in Declansburg’s November 2022 election for Prime Minister, a moment that represented a cultural turning point for the region and a seismic shift for Declansburg’s regional government,
Ehhhhh
Open to being convinced otherwise, but I don't really buy that the nominee's commendable
Right, its a bit ...
Registering myself as against
Not a good proposal
I see the name Declansburg, and my body shutters
dang i feel bad it seems like they got no substantial feedback on their latest draft
but yeah as-is the resolution isnt great
also wow that's interesting
there's a class UCR swining 100 endorsements
Class sizes getting too big is a real problem but this is ridiculous
Back in my day 35 students was considered big!
its probably from multipe periods if i have to guess
But it’s fun to picture 2 to a desk with everyone else bunched up staring through the window

I’m willing to bet they’ll get commended sooner or later with a better draft. Q mentioned in the thread that he’s had positive interactions with the region, so knowing how he operates, he’ll probably write this one off as a lost cause and make a deal with them for help drafting/passing in exchange for something
yeah that's a good guess
Don’t feel too bad on the feedback front. Their new draft was only up for like a week before submission
Took me a second because they didn’t put their old stuff in the OP lol

My elitism’s showing but I don’t *personally* consider anyone solely involved in a UCR that size to be commendable. My floor’s something like Forest or Refugia which have unique histories and characters in addition to being significantly bigger
Don’t think Rom’s commendable either but here we are

I don't really agree - it's true that typically more people who are C/Cable come from large regions, but if you aren't involved in recruitment or integration then none of your work will correlate with region size if we're talking about cultural events hosting like The Salaxans or Anyia

UCR size is an important factor when evaluating claims revolving around recruitment and integration, and yeah at some point if you want to showcase a regionbuilder they'd have to actually been a part of a community that isn't a one man inactive show, but I think even 30 endo UCRs meet that community size requirement
see caer cidi when it was still open

so long as your actions show merit and excellence beyond other players in regionbuilding, i think a c/c is possible. And while that does tend to correlate with region size, it is not an exact association
and i think small communities are good grounds for C/C nominees, if the C/C nominee in question actually did commendable stuff. key word is small versus dead heh
Perhaps it’s that correlation
Fine line between a small community and a dead one and while plenty of significant figures were important to a small community they often don’t stick around
Ghost being a good example
Texas being probably the best counterexample
Big Tex was iconic
yeah that's true

its also a numbers game - its very rare to have a player from a region to write SC resolutions, and people mostly write resolutions for friends or people historic to their region. so bigger regions are more likely to have WA resolutions written for their players compared to smol ones
and even spiritus or caer cidi are kinda exceptions to general small communities because both were home to very notable NSGPers and both had extensive FA networks with the big regions
which is why in general you never see a commend from a no-name small region that's CS or Spiritus's size
Changed the channel name: [AT VOTE - AGAINST] SC - Commend Staidear
Mmm? What's wrong with them?
@A mean old man AGAINST
I love how these tight votes are due to apathy and not the nominee being controversial
Changed the channel name: [PASSED] SC - Commend Staidear
Commend Staidear was passed 6,809 votes to 4,300 (61.3% support).
